description: The bar chart compares the runtime of different models in seconds. The horizontal axis lists the model names, including "Our Joint Framework", "ChatGPT", "DeepSeek", "LLaMA", and "Claude", while the vertical axis is labeled "Runtime (seconds)" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 400 seconds, marked at intervals of 50 seconds. The chart features two types of bars: a dark green bar representing "Our Joint Framework" and light blue bars representing the "LLM Models". The dark green bar for "Our Joint Framework" has a runtime of 77 seconds, while the light blue bars have runtimes of 190 seconds for "ChatGPT", 365 seconds for "DeepSeek", 172 seconds for "LLaMA", and 243 seconds for "Claude". The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and the "Our Joint Framework" bar is visually distinct due to its dark green color. The chart provides a clear visual representation of the runtime comparison among the different models.
